WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT
    location_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN close_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shops_trading

    location_code <> -1

  COUNT(DISTINCT location_code) AS sites_closed

  shops_trading = 0

body.value: One figure: 9 — the number of distinct places that once had a physical Contoso shop standing on them and have none trading today, counted over the whole history the store dimension holds, with no date window. Each is a place where every shop that ever traded there has closed and nothing replaced it; the closures run from 2015-05-05 to 2019-08-08, and the last shop at every one of the 9 is annotated Closed, none Restructured. Counted once per place and not once per shop — site 46 held two shops in succession and counts once. What the figure does NOT include: the 5 places that saw a shop close but were re-let and are trading today (including those would give 14); the 52 places whose single shop has never closed; the 16 shop closures themselves, which is a premises count and a different question; and the web shop, which has no premises and no place.

WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT
    location_code,
    COUNT(*) AS shops_ever,
    SUM(CASE WHEN close_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shops_trading,
    MAX(close_date) AS last_close_date
  FROM contoso_served.dim_store
  WHERE
    location_code <> -1
  GROUP BY
    location_code
)
SELECT
  p.location_code,
  p.shops_ever,
  p.last_close_date,
  s.store_name,
  s.status_annotation
FROM per_site AS p
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON s.location_code = p.location_code AND s.close_date = p.last_close_date
WHERE
  p.shops_trading = 0
ORDER BY
  p.location_code

WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT
    location_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN close_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shops_trading
  FROM contoso_served.dim_store
  WHERE
    location_code <> -1
  GROUP BY
    location_code
), dead AS (
  SELECT
    location_code
  FROM per_site
  WHERE
    shops_trading = 0
), last_shop AS (
  SELECT
    s.location_code,
    s.status_annotation,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.location_code ORDER BY s.close_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  JOIN dead AS d
    ON d.location_code = s.location_code
)
SELECT
  l.status_annotation AS status_of_last_shop_to_close,
  COUNT(*) AS sites_with_nothing_trading,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      location_code <> -1 AND status_annotation = 'Closed'
  ) AS sites_holding_a_shop_shut_for_good,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      location_code <> -1 AND NOT close_date IS NULL
  ) AS sites_where_any_shop_ever_closed
FROM last_shop AS l
WHERE
  l.rn = 1
GROUP BY
  l.status_annotation
